problem_statement: Return a new list with the elements of values rotated left by k positions. A left rotation by k moves each element k positions toward the front, wrapping around. values is a Python list of integers (excluding bool); k is a non-negative integer. For an empty list return an empty list. Do not modify the input.
valid_input_domain: Return a new list with the elements of values rotated left by k positions. A left rotation by k moves each element k positions toward the front, wrapping around. values is a Python list of integers (excluding bool); k is a non-negative integer. bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses (i + k) % n instead of (i - k) % n, rotating right instead of left.
